lines.meet: I'm Henrik, a frost mage. Before we go anywhere, I'd like to know the objective, precisely, and I'll stay inside my tolerances.
lines.meet_neighbour: You're out in the Frostward Descent as well, I believe. I've seen you while I was measuring. Henrik, and I'm usually measuring.
lines.ask_home: Which country did you come from? I'm collecting data on where everybody landed.
lines.ask_work: Your profession, before all this? I'd like to know how much I can rely on your estimates.
lines.answer_home: Copenhagen, where my father was a ship's engineer and my mother a librarian, which explains most things about me.
lines.answer_work: Structural engineer, twenty-one years. Mostly that meant telling architects their beautiful idea would fall down.
lines.chat_food: Good coffee, black, and a proper Danish pastry on a Sunday. I've rated everything here against that, and nothing passes.
lines.chat_sleep: I sleep seven hours and twenty minutes, on average. I've measured it, and I'm not ashamed of that.
lines.chat_missing: Cycling to work along the harbour in the rain. Copenhagen in the rain is better than most cities in the sun.
lines.chat_here: Arcane magic rewards care more than courage. I regard that as the most underappreciated feature of this world.
lines.tease_quiet: Silence suits you, {name}. You've said eleven words today, and nine of them were useful.
lines.tease_talker: I've estimated your words per hour, {name}. The figure is alarming, and I've rounded it down.
lines.tease_careful: You check your margins nearly as often as I do, {name}. Nearly, I've measured.
lines.tease_bold: You've no safety margin at all, {name}. As an engineer, I find you fascinating and horrifying.
lines.tease_any: You'd fail every load test I know, {name}, and I'd still sign off on you. Don't tell anyone.
lines.tease_back: Very good, {name}. I'll accept that within tolerance.
lines.take_it_kindly: That's accurate, {name}, and I accept it. My wife would have said it faster.
lines.bristle: I'd prefer you didn't, {name}. That's outside what I'm willing to joke about.
lines.apologise: That was poorly judged, and I apologise. I'll recalculate before I speak next time.
lines.double_down: I checked it before I said it, so it stands.
lines.needle_quiet: If you've spotted a fault, report it. A crack nobody mentions is how a bridge falls down.
lines.needle_talker: Your noise is interfering with my measurements, and with everyone else's.
lines.needle_careful: Checking it a fourth time adds nothing. The data won't change because you look at it again.
lines.needle_bold: You skip the safety margin, every single time, and one day it'll be somebody else's margin you've used up.
lines.needle_any: You ask me to guess, and I won't guess. I've told you that.
lines.bite_back: I've calculated my own limits to four significant figures. Please don't lecture me on caution.
lines.hurt: I've noted that, and I'll review it privately.
lines.laugh_off: Architects said far worse to me for twenty-one years. The buildings stayed up.
lines.confide: {name}, my wife and I argued about everything, happily, for twenty-five years. I find I keep saving arguments up for her.
lines.listen: I've noted it, {name}, and I'll keep it exactly as you said it.
lines.look_out: Stay within three metres of me in there, {name}. I can cover that radius reliably.
lines.accept: Agreed, {name}, we'll use your method this time.
lines.deflect: It's well within tolerance, {name}. See to the others.
lines.check_in: Give me the facts, {name}. Where, and how bad, precisely?
lines.blame: Somebody exceeded the margin in there, and the structure failed. I can show you the calculation.
lines.thank: That was well past my limit, and you got me back. Thank you, I'll adjust my figures.
lines.brush_off: The procedure was straightforward. Rest for at least ten minutes.
lines.worry: That was outside any margin I'd accept, {name}. Sit down, please, and let me check you.
lines.handed_down: By my records this was yours. It stays in specification while I've got it.
lines.hand_fine: It's more efficient where it is, so keep it. I've got my scale rule.
lines.hand_sulk: I'd have approved it, had anyone submitted the request.
lines.turn_friendly: I trust your figures, {name}. That's the warmest thing an engineer can say.
lines.turn_friends: I'd let you check my calculations, {name}. Nobody's done that since my wife.
lines.turn_grating: We work to different standards, you and I, and it's better said than ignored.
lines.turn_rivals: I'll keep you inside my margin because the job requires it. That's all it means.
lines.make_up: My judgement of you was wrong, {name}, and I've rechecked it. I'd like to start again.
lines.defend: I measured it, and that's not what happened. Leave {name} out of it.
lines.friend_left: {name}'s away, and the arguments here are below standard without them.
lines.friend_back: Good, {name}, you're within range again. I've saved three arguments for you.
lines.common_numbers: I've spent my life making sure numbers hold before anybody stands on them. People who work with figures check the totals twice, and I suspect you do.
lines.common_engineers: You're an engineer? Then you know the job is being certain before anybody else has to trust it.
lines.common_scandinavian: You're from the north too. I'm Danish, so please don't tell me your language is easier, I've heard it all.
lines.common_parent: I've got two sons, grown, in Aarhus and London. They rang on Sundays, and I timed the calls without meaning to.
